primary_findings.finding: Explicit Western Huasteca argument-marking discussion identifies fused first-person-object patterns, and table marks WHN differences. Third-person-object imperative paradigm provides context, but exact local Xij- forms here are taken from the existing catalogue, not generated by replacing thesis spelling. No draft involving first-person object was invented.

Modern Western data document variation: fluent speakers use unmarked inanimate nouns for plural referents; others pluralize. Numeral phrases can contain unmarked nouns. Thus missing plural suffix alone is not a defect in Add images, these images or20 image count. Conversely no blanket rule forces all modern WHN inanimates to stay singular.
Ax=miac is explicitly glossed not many. Supports keeping the prior concern that amo miyac is not equivalent to comparative fewer; no grammar-based promotion of that candidate.
Source uses ACK orthography for own unpublished data and discusses multiple conventions. Preserve existing catalogue spelling; no automatic conversion to other variant orthographies.

source_boundaries: The xi-cochi example near text lines4899 is general/Classical background, not independent modern Western elicitation. It is NOT sole evidence for acceptance.
Pipil comparison sections are not used as Western Huasteca evidence.
Tenek chapters, including section6.15 human/inanimate examples, were excluded from Nahuatl conclusions.
Table3.11 is a comparative Huasteca paradigm adapted from Beller and Beller with WHN distinctions; not every cell is new author fieldwork.
Inanimate nominal-number flexibility does not prove arbitrary verb-number agreement or all proposed motlalijtoc passive/resultative forms.
No whole-phrase/native certification is required for the five low-new-grammar recommendations; unresolved semantic/technical changes still held.
remaining_key_holds: Placed/resultative morphology and attachment-vs-assembled distinction remain held.
Legal credits remain narrower than full attribution; DERECHO DE AUTOR source can support copyright noun, not rehabilitate these prose paraphrases.
Create output/assembly compound instructions not promoted solely because general morphology exists; parent may combine separate lexical/technical review.
Largest/smallest not justified from Pipil comparative material.
